amanda: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands about the outage. RCA link (internal): https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-05-04-routing-backpressure . Please drop short clarifying Qs and who will own action items.

sree: I can own the immediate routing fallback patch. Plan: conservative limiter + canary. PR today, canary tonight.

lia: I will add a dashboard tile for retry-loop-rate and an alert. ETA tomorrow morning for the tile, runbook by Monday.

kelsey: I’ll update the incident runbook and include detection steps for retry storms. Will post links when done.

jay: Product: if we need a hotfix, who will own customer outreach? Also need an exec-friendly one-pager.

amanda: Kelsey can draft the one-pager after security approves the sanitized RCA. Jay will coordinate outreach if we hotfix.

deploy-bot: deploy 1783456900 started by sree 1% canary rollout initiated.

amanda: Minimal repro snippet (sanitized):
``
2026-05-04T10:12:05Z router: upstream-reset retries=4
2026-05-04T10:12:05Z worker: prefix_hit=false kv_warm=false
2026-05-04T10:12:06Z router: retry_policy=aggressive attempt=5
```

sree: After canary watch, I’ll post PR and rollback criteria.

amanda: Thanks all 1 will close when PR, dashboard, and one-pager links are in the follow-up doc.
